Experience: 5+ năm

Mô tả công việc

MARUSYS is a leading technology company specializing in broadband device development and embedded systems. We are looking for experienced Software Developers to join our talented team and contribute to innovative projects.

Responsibilities:
  • Design and develop software for broadband devices (routers, modems, gateways)
  • Develop firmware and embedded system solutions using C++ and TypeScript
  • Implement microservices architecture for device communication
  • Participate in code review and quality assurance processes
  • Collaborate with hardware team to optimize software performance
  • Troubleshoot and debug complex system issues
  • Document technical specifications and development processes
  • Contribute to the improvement of development practices and tools
Requirements:
  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong proficiency in C++ and/or TypeScript/Node.js
  • Experience with embedded systems and firmware development
  • Knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, WiFi, Ethernet)
  • Experience with microservices architecture and API design
  • Proficiency in version control systems (Git)
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Experience with testing frameworks and debugging tools
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities
  • English proficiency (Reading/Writing minimum)
Nice to Have:
  • Experience with Docker and containerization
  • Knowledge of AWS or cloud services
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Background in IoT (Internet of Things)
  • Open source contributions
Benefits:
  • Competitive salary: 8-12 triệu VND (based on experience)
  • Full health insurance and social insurance
  • Annual performance bonus
  • Professional development opportunities and training budget
  • Flexible working hours and remote work options
  • Company trip and team building activities
  • Modern work environment with latest technologies
  • Career advancement opportunities
